age_calculation.name: Age
age_calculation.description: Calculates the subject's age at the time of the baseline visit.

body_mass_index.name: Body Mass Index (BMI)
body_mass_index.description: Calculates the Body Mass Index, a measure of body fat based on height and weight. Assumes height is in meters and weight is in kilograms.

body_surface_area_mosteller.name: Body Surface Area (BSA) - Mosteller Formula
body_surface_area_mosteller.description: Estimates the total surface area of the human body. Commonly used to index cardiac parameters. Assumes height in cm and weight in kg.

waist_to_hip_ratio.name: Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR)
waist_to_hip_ratio.description: A measure of body fat distribution and a predictor of health risk.

pulse_pressure.name: Pulse Pressure
pulse_pressure.description: The difference between systolic and diastolic blood pressure, representing the force the heart generates each time it contracts.
pulse_pressure.expression: Pulse Pressure (mmHg) = Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure

mean_arterial_pressure.name: Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)
mean_arterial_pressure.description: An average blood pressure in an individual during a single cardiac cycle.
mean_arterial_pressure.expression: MAP (mmHg) = Diastolic blood pressure + (1/3 * (Systolic blood pressure - Diastolic blood pressure))

egfr_ckd_epi.name: Estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR) - CKD-EPI
egfr_ckd_epi.description: Estimates GFR from serum creatinine, age, and sex. The CKD-EPI 2021 equation is the current standard. The exact formula is complex and depends on creatinine levels relative to sex-specific constants.

ast_alt_ratio.name: AST/ALT Ratio (De Ritis Ratio)
ast_alt_ratio.description: The ratio of Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) to Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT). It can help determine the cause of liver damage.

fib_4_score.name: FIB-4 Score for Liver Fibrosis
fib_4_score.description: A non-invasive score to estimate the degree of liver fibrosis in patients with liver disease.

homa_ir.name: Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance (HOMA-IR)
homa_ir.description: A method used to quantify insulin resistance and beta-cell function. Assumes glucose in mmol/L and insulin in mU/L.

non_hdl_cholesterol.name: Non-HDL Cholesterol
non_hdl_cholesterol.description: Calculates the total cholesterol minus HDL cholesterol, representing all atherogenic lipoprotein particles.

atherogenic_index_of_plasma.name: Atherogenic Index of Plasma (AIP)
atherogenic_index_of_plasma.description: A strong marker to predict atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease risk. Calculated on a logarithmic scale. Assumes Triglycerides and HDLc are in mmol/L.

ejection_fraction_simpson.name: Ejection Fraction (from Volumes)
ejection_fraction_simpson.description: The volumetric fraction of blood pumped from the left ventricle with each heartbeat, calculated from end-diastolic and end-systolic volumes.

stroke_volume_simpson.name: Stroke Volume (from Volumes)
stroke_volume_simpson.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat.

stroke_volume_doppler.name: Stroke Volume (Doppler Method)
stroke_volume_doppler.description: The volume of blood pumped from the left ventricle per beat, calculated using the LVOT diameter and VTI.

cardiac_output_doppler.name: Cardiac Output (Doppler Method)
cardiac_output_doppler.description: The volume of blood pumped by the heart per minute, derived from stroke volume and heart rate.

e_a_ratio.name: E/A Ratio
e_a_ratio.description: Ratio of the early (E) to late (A) diastolic mitral inflow velocities, a measure of diastolic function.

e_e_prime_ratio.name: E/e' Ratio (Average)
e_e_prime_ratio.description: Ratio of early mitral inflow velocity (E) to the average of septal and lateral mitral annular early diastolic velocities (e'). A key indicator of LV filling pressures.

relative_wall_thickness.name: Relative Wall Thickness (RWT)
relative_wall_thickness.description: An echocardiographic measurement used to classify the pattern of left ventricular hypertrophy.

lv_mass_index.name: Left Ventricular Mass Index (LVMI)
lv_mass_index.description: Left ventricular mass, calculated using the Devereux formula, indexed to Body Surface Area (BSA) to assess for hypertrophy.
lv_mass_index.expression: LVM = 0.8 * (1.04 * ((LVEDD + EDPWT + EDSWT)^3 - LVEDD^3)) + 0.6; LVMI = LVM / BSA

la_volume_index.name: Left Atrial Volume Index (LAVI)
la_volume_index.description: Left atrial volume indexed to Body Surface Area (BSA), a robust marker of chronic diastolic dysfunction and cardiovascular risk.

average_gls.name: Average Global Longitudinal Strain (GLS)
average_gls.description: The average of longitudinal strain values from the 2, 3, and 4-chamber apical views, providing a comprehensive measure of left ventricular systolic function.

average_gcs.name: Average Global Circumferential Strain (GCS)
average_gcs.description: The average of circumferential strain values from the basal, mid, and apical short-axis views.

cha2ds2_vasc_score.name: CHA2DS2-VASc Score
cha2ds2_vasc_score.description: A clinical prediction rule for estimating the risk of stroke in patients with non-valvular atrial fibrillation (AF).
cha2ds2_vasc_score.expression: Score based on: C(CHF: Dyspnea>I), H(Hypertension: SBP>140 or on meds), A2(Age≥75), D(Diabetes), S2(Stroke: not available), V(Vascular Disease: not available), A(Age 65-74), Sc(Sex: female).

has_bled_score.name: HAS-BLED Score
has_bled_score.description: A clinical prediction rule for estimating the 1-year risk of major bleeding in patients on anticoagulation for atrial fibrillation (AF).
has_bled_score.expression: Score based on: H(Hypertension: SBP>160), A(Abnormal renal/liver function: GFR<60 or elevated liver enzymes), S(Stroke: not available), B(Bleeding history: not available), L(Labile INR: not available), E(Elderly: Age>65), D(Drugs/Alcohol).

cholesterol_conversion_gL_to_mmolL.name: Cholesterol Unit Conversion (g/L to mmol/L)
cholesterol_conversion_gL_to_mmolL.description: Converts cholesterol concentration from grams per liter (g/L) to millimoles per liter (mmol/L).

triglycerides_conversion_gL_to_mmolL.name: Triglycerides Unit Conversion (g/L to mmol/L)
triglycerides_conversion_gL_to_mmolL.description: Converts triglyceride concentration from grams per liter (g/L) to millimoles per liter (mmol/L).
